sources.label: VORON V2.4 R2
sources.author: VoronDesign
sources.scope: 250の公式アセンブリから構築したV2.4 350基準モデル。
sources.changes: 350 mm寸法への再配置。選択部品の重複を除き、スカート・ラッチ・固定具・ベッドの取付面を調整。 Zレール固定用ナットをM3へ交換してレール裏の溝へ配置。XYを含む68組のレール固定ナットをボルト軸に合わせて調整。 Complete 250/300/350 upper and lower latch groups are registered to the door seam and native magnet recesses.

notices: Custom dimensions derived from native VORON 350 mm reference parts. Rigid hardware retains native dimensions.
Native 25 mm skirt cells are repeated with the original logo and end mount sections retained. This is an advisory 1000 mm reference, not an official size or a tested build kit.
Moving belts are smooth route previews; teeth, tension and electrical wiring mechanics are not simulated.
External PTFE is a variable-length flexible viewer preview and is not included in native STEP assembly body counts.

sources.label: VORON Trident R2
sources.author: VoronDesign
sources.scope: Independent standard Trident 250 / 300 / 350 chassis, fixed frame, three Z guides, moving bed and 6 mm R2 gantries.
sources.changes: Rigid native hardware retains its dimensions. Size-specific rails preserve native periodic hole pitch and fixing axes. Extrusions, bed and panels use central or perimeter inserts. Static mounting references and native Z limits remain disclosed.

sources.label: Stealthburner / Clockwork 2 / Revo CAD
sources.author: VoronDesign
sources.scope: SBのRevo Voron・Rapido HF・Dragon SF/HF・V6用CW2マウント、前面本体、CW2修復用形状。
sources.changes: 配置・表示用三角形化・配色の調整。機種ごとの変更履歴を検証記録に保存。

notices: Custom dimensions derived from native VORON 350 mm reference parts. Rigid hardware retains native dimensions.
Native 25 mm skirt cells are repeated with the original logo and end mount sections retained. This is an advisory 1000 mm reference, not an official size or a tested build kit.
Moving belts are smooth route previews; teeth, tension and electrical wiring mechanics are not simulated.
PTFE is a variable-length hollow viewer reference derived from the native 4/3 mm section. Cut length, retention and continuous native clearance are unverified.
The extended native-link bed chain is registered at its native high pose; full 1000 mm articulated travel and wiring mechanics require further qualification.

Preview bed descent is limited to 994 mm. Contacts646 is the lowest rigid bed component; its source support bound remains above the deck at this limit. Full-machine clearance and firmware homing remain unverified.

Reference chain repair: 68 original link bodies are rolled 180 degrees about their measured hinge chords; the upper fixed end, its three screws and inserts, and printed insert568 move together by Y -0.114500534 mm. Rail and carriage remain unchanged.

Native source constraints remain unqualified: the upper fixed-end/link contact is 0.400133 mm3 and the printed insert568/link contact is 14.576066 mm3. Original350 CAD measures 0.400133 mm3 and 18.915325 mm3 for those pairs. These positive contacts are retained explicitly; intended snap engagement, whole-machine fit and continuous clearance are not certified.

internal_spool_source.name: Trident Internal Spool Holder · elcrni
internal_spool_source.license: GPL-3.0; added native VORON hardware retains original component terms
internal_spool_source.scope: Original v32 holder and guides with rigid roller phase corrections, native VORON fixings, a relocated lower guide and an upper guide mounted below the rear frame member. Author sizes 300/350, capacity Ø200 × up to 75 mm. Actual spool body and filament route are not included. Exact host installation qualification is kept in a separate receipt.

requested_mods.scope: Author uploads retain their separately recorded GPL / CC BY / CC BY-SA / CC BY-NC terms. Derived components and installation reviews have separate hashes and scopes.
